title: LoadingState
responsibility: Show a reusable, accessible loading status with a decorative indicator while the host waits for data.

inputs.name: LoadingState.label
inputs.description: Optional status label describing the data being read; defaults to Loading…. The host owns fetching and decides when to show or remove the status.

inputs.name: LoadingState.inline
inputs.description: Show the decorative ring and label together in normal document flow. Defaults to false for a viewport-centered loading status.

outputs.name: LoadingState
outputs.description: A polite, atomic status with a decorative ring and label. Defaults to a viewport-centered ring with its label below; inline mode places a smaller ring beside the label in document flow. Pointer events pass through and reduced motion keeps the ring still.
